what: Area 23, campus directory: the existing contact items gain optional directory details (category, building, room, map address, opening information, accessibility, directions, source page, last-checked date). Students see them in a Campus directory group; anything staff did not give is shown as not provided. Map links use the same Google and Apple Maps search links as the app’s place cards and are off for demo organisations, whose places are labelled fictional.
